sources.name: Hire Heroes USA
sources.description: Nonprofit providing free veteran career coaching, resume review, job board, and employer partnerships for transitioning service members and military spouses. Surfaced as a referral resource — no public API.
sources.access_method: Referral only — direct veterans to hireheroesusa.org for free coaching and job board access. No scraping or API.
sources.trust_level: High - established 501(c)(3) with DoD and VA partnerships

sources.name: LinkedIn Jobs
sources.description: Major professional networking and job posting platform. No freely accessible search API — LinkedIn's Jobs API requires a paid partner agreement. Job description text is obtained via RAG-009 (user-provided paste).
sources.access_method: User-provided paste (see RAG-009) — direct veterans to linkedin.com/jobs to find and copy job descriptions. Live API integration not feasible without partner agreement.
sources.trust_level: Medium - commercial platform; job postings are employer-authored and unverified
sources.notes: API access requires LinkedIn partner agreement. ToS prohibits scraping. Veterans should copy-paste JDs into the tool (RAG-009).

sources.name: Indeed Job Postings
sources.description: High-volume job aggregator. Indeed deprecated its public Publisher API in 2023; no freely accessible search API remains. Job description text is obtained via RAG-009 (user-provided paste).
sources.access_method: User-provided paste (see RAG-009) — direct veterans to indeed.com to find and copy job descriptions. Live API integration not feasible without an enterprise agreement.
sources.trust_level: Medium - commercial aggregator; job postings are employer-authored and unverified
sources.notes: Publisher API deprecated 2023. ToS prohibits scraping. Veterans should copy-paste JDs into the tool (RAG-009).
